items.title: Bitcoin’s golden cross is here
items.snippet: A golden cross has triggered on bitcoin's daily price chart, indicating a potential long-term bullish trend ahead.
items.note: Позитивний тон для BTC за ключовими словами.

items.title: Australia says it removed 45 crypto, remittance registrations over the past year
items.snippet: AUSTRAC said its yearlong sweep included canceled, suspended and unrenewed registrations, while its action against GetCoins helped disrupt organized investment scams.
items.note: Негативний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: Liquid Network gets back 3,400 bitcoin from whitehat hackers; talks underway for the rest
items.snippet: Supposed whitehat hackers behind Sunday’s Liquid Network breach have returned 3,400 of the 4,000 BTC they took, but nearly $47 million in bitcoin is still outstanding.
items.note: Негативний тон для BTC за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: Bitcoin slips under $79,000, Zcash leads losses as Fed hike odds hold near 60%
items.snippet: Every major token fell on Tuesday, though most keep weekly gains, with traders pricing a 60% chance of a Fed hike next week.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо BTC -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.

items.title: Liquid ‘white hats’ return $270M in Bitcoin as network prepares restart
items.snippet: The actors returned 85% of the Bitcoin withdrawn from Liquid’s federation wallet following the security incident.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо BTC -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.
